notes.title: Day One Fixes – Patch Notes
notes.notes:
Hey everyone!

Thank you all for participating in the game’s launch! We've made some improvements based on early feedback. Here’s what’s new in the first update:

[list]
[*][b]Motion Blur Option[/b]: You can now enable or disable motion blur in the settings.
[*][b]Bug Fix[/b]: Fixed a rare issue where players could fall into the void after the first floor.
[*][b]Final Level Adjustment[/b]: We’ve rebalanced the final level slightly.
[*][b]Jump Scare Frequency[/b]: Some jump scares no longer repeat.
[*][b]Collection Mode Changes[/b]: This mode is meant for finding all anomalies after finishing the game.
  For this reason, [i]error strikes[/i] and [i]ambient sounds[/i] have been disabled.
  The help menu also provides a clearer explanation.
[/list]

We’re grateful for your support and feedback. For any further feedback or suggestions, feel free to reach out in the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/3510310/discussions/]Community Hub[/url].

Stay tuned for more updates!

notes.title: A Quick Update Before Launch
notes.notes:
Hey everyone!

We’re just a few hours away from the official release, and we wanted to take a moment to share a quick update with you all. The final preparations are in full swing, and we’re making sure everything is as polished as possible for launch day.

What We’ve Been Working On:

[list]
[*]Final Bug Fixes – We’ve been addressing some last-minute issues to ensure a smooth and immersive experience.
[*]Performance Improvements – Optimizing the game to run better across different hardware setups.
[*]Last-Minute Adjustments – Fine-tuning gameplay elements based on internal testing and feedback to ensure the best possible balance and experience.
[/list]

What’s Next?

We’re incredibly excited for you to experience the game firsthand! After launch, we’ll be closely monitoring your feedback, addressing any issues that arise, and working on potential updates to refine and enhance the experience even further.

Your support means the world to us, and we truly appreciate your patience and enthusiasm. Stay tuned for more updates, and get ready to jump in—release is just around the corner!

See you soon in the game!
